VM - Close loose contexts.vi

Owning Palette: Advanced VarMan VIs

Searches for loose contexts and closes any found.

Details

Click the parameters for more information

 

VC handles (all) is optional parameter that specifies handles of variable contexts that need to be examined. If it is an empty array (by default), the VI examines all opened local contexts and closes ones that meet "context is loose" condition.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
num of closed returns number of closed contexts.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains VarMan VI error code identifying an error if any occurred. If no error occurred, it is equal to zero.
source contains the error description and VI location information if an error occurred.

 

VM - Close loose contexts.vi - details

The VI examines a context for being loose by the following way:
The VI retrieves Creator and context life time attributes specified when the context was created (see VM - Open Context.vi). Then it opens a reference to the VI specified by Creator and acquires its state. The VI assumes the context is loose if the creator VI is not in a state compatible with context life time.

Note that this technique cannot guarantee that all actually loose contexts are closed. Good practice is to explicitly close contexts. Use VM - Close Context.vi to close a context.
